inviteCodeDesc: Share this code so family members can join.
joinError: That code wasn't found. Please check and try again.
joinErrorTooManyAttempts: Too many codes were tried. Please wait an hour, then try again with the code your family shared.
joinErrorNetwork: We couldn't reach Sober Helpline. Check your connection and try again.
joinErrorAlreadyInFamily: You're already part of another family space. To use this code, first leave that space from the bottom of its family card.
noFamilyBody: Create a shared space to agree on boundaries — the castle walls that protect your family — and support each other in keeping them.
familyNameNote: Only members you invite will see this space.
proposeSuccess: Wall proposed — your family will see it.
waveringTitle: It's okay — this is why you practice.
waveringBody: Wavering is information, not failure. You're still in it.
waveringShareQ: Let your family know? They'll get a supportive message, not a judgment.
weeklyCheckIn: Did you hold your walls this week?
weeklyNote: This stays private unless you choose to share with your family.
createErrorMessage: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support.
proposeErrorMessage: Check your connection and try again.
backupNotice: {{name}} could use backup on a wall.

sharedScript.body: This wall is aligned. Everyone rehearses the same words — mixed messages are how the family gets split.

holdLog.title: Did you hold your walls this week?
holdLog.body: This is about whether the family held — not whether your loved one used. Private unless you choose to share.
holdLog.shared: Shared with Family Space this week.
holdLog.errorMessage: Check your connection and try again.

leaveBody: You'll stop seeing your family's shared boundaries and journal. Boundaries you proposed and journal notes you wrote stay with your family. If you started this space, it passes to the longest-standing member.
leaveAloneBody: No one else has joined yet, so leaving deletes this space for good, including its journal and shared boundaries. This can't be undone.
leaveErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
actionErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.
